label: Coverage, from same-supporter presence
description: Coverage follows from the existing open premise that whatever supports a being necessary from w, at a world where it exists, also exists at w and supports it at w. Coverage is strictly weaker on its concrete domain: in the rooted-pair control coverage holds while same-supporter presence fails. Not registered as a strength order because the existing users of the stronger premise conclude about all candidates, not concreta only. Conditional consequence only.
